findings.description: The docstring says the section is written "if at least one is documented", but the condition uses all(...) over the arguments. The section is skipped when only some arguments have help. It is also written with an empty record list when there are no arguments.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has two arguments and only one has help=..., or it has no arguments at all. In the first case all() is False, so the documented argument vanishes from the help output. In the second case all([]) is True, so an empty "Positional arguments" section header is printed for every command without arguments. The fix is any(...) on the arguments.
